text:
Nina (CSM): FYI: CobaltAI asked for a quick QBR-style spend sanity check ahead of renewal. They reported surprise embed costs; want a 90-day forecast + simple remediation checklist. Can FinOps + Analytics do conservative/expected/high scenarios and a recommended alert rule? cc @Omar @Clara
Omar (FinOps): On it. I'll calculate billed tokens and $ using $0.00050/token. Output will have three rows + monthlyized projection. Prefer billed tokens unless they ask for gross.
Clara (Analytics): Running route breakout. Query: ```SELECT date, route, SUM(tokens) t FROM usage WHERE account='cobaltai' GROUP BY date, route;``` I'll export CSV and include p95.
Ben (AE): Context: they turned on embeddings for product search + a nightly re-sync. Onboarding ~72%. Renewal ~55 days. They flagged "no per-route billing" and want invoice clarity.
ops-bot: [automated] Anomaly detected for cobaltai: 3-day avg tokens increased 2.8x (detected 2026-05-05).
Tess (Enablement): I can run a 30-min "cost triage" session: prefix caching, per-route quotas, SDK batching. Will include copy-paste alert webhook and a throttling example. Proposed Thu 9am PT.
Nina (CSM): Great. Omar please include sensitivity (±10/25/50%). Also add an "auto-guard" rule we can propose to the customer.
Omar (FinOps): Draft guard rule: ```if route('search-embed').avg24h > baseline*2.5 then POST /webhooks/cs-alert {"acct":"cobaltai","type":"spike"}; apply_rate_limit(route='search-embed', pct=60)``` I'll add thresholds and rationale in the CSV.
Clara (Analytics): Uploaded: https://files.redwood/cobaltai-90d-forecast.csv. Notes: median daily tokens overall=20k; re-sync correlated with two >130k days on 2026-04-28 and 2026-05-03; route p95 for search-embed = 48k.
Ben (AE): I'll request they stagger re-syncs and confirm which routes are non-critical. If they accept the enablement slot we can push immediate mitigations.
Nina (CSM): Can we meet 2pm PT today to finalize the one-pager (forecast table + alert rule + enablement invite)?
Omar (FinOps): 14:00 PT works. I'll have the three-row table + $ estimates ready.
Tess (Enablement): I'll draft the 4-step checklist and include runnable SDK snippets.
ops-bot: [system] Next summary will post at 13:30 PT with updated metrics.
Nina (CSM): Thanks everyone 680. Aim: leave the customer with a clear action list to avoid surprise bills and a short runway for renewal talks.
